thread:
emma: Quick check-in: new pricing experiment (price_v4) planned. Need CSV contract, grandfather rules, vendor carve-outs, and AR flags. Canary 5% for 5 days.

noah: I can update ingestion. Proposed CSV cols: account_id,rate_code,qty,grandfather_ts,retro_flag,manual_review.

rita: A/B arms: A=stable (v3), B=price_v4 tiered. Exclude reserved capacity + contracts with explicit no-retro clauses. I'll compile exclude list.

samir: Legal: any vendor clause mentioning "retro liability cap" or "no unilateral rebates" gets auto-exclude unless consented. Will post contract IDs by EOD.

olivia: AR rules: flag invoices where abs(delta) > $1.5k OR pct_delta > 30%. Need CSV export and auto-ticket creation. Also prefer a "PRIO-AR" label for >$5k.

noah: Sample CSV row for ingest: 
account_id,rate_code,qty,grandfather_ts,retro_flag,manual_review
C-500,price_v4_t1,120,0,true,true

billing-bot: preflight checks: schema-validate, staging-sim, exclude-list, ar-export. All must pass in staging.

emma: Gating to proceed: staging invoice success > 99%, median invoice drift < 12%, manual queue < 60, estimated retro < $7k. Rollback plan: immediate switch to arm A + retro hold.

rita: I'll generate cohort SQL and the opt-in list from sales. Also note accounts with delayed usage ingestion (>48h) should be excluded.

samir: Posted vendor carve-outs in the legal doc. 8 accounts flagged; will share reasons.

olivia: AR sheet ready: https://sheets.redwood.co/AR-PRICING-REVIEW-2190. Webhook hooked to create PRIO tickets for flagged rows.

noah: Opening PR for schema + sim harness now. Will include export sample and webhook payload docs.

emma: Thanks team. Action items: Noah 1 PR; Rita 1 cohort & excludes; Samir 1 vendor list; Olivia 1 AR wiring. We'll reconvene after PR passes staging. :thumbsup:
